The SharePoint Framework is the recommended development model to extend the modern SharePoint experience. In this learning path, you'll learn how to customize and extend SharePoint using the SharePoint Framework using web parts and extensions.

Title: Introduction to building AI agents
Description: Explore how AI agents work, tour Microsoft's agent development platform — including Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit — and learn how to plan and design an agent solution for your scenario.

Title: Design and set up your Viva Glint program
Description: Learn how to set up the Viva Glint platform as well as configure and launch a Viva Glint recurring survey.

Title: MS-102 Explore data governance in Microsoft 365
Description: This learning path introduces you to the data governance features of Microsoft 365, which serve regulatory compliance, can facilitate eDiscovery, and are part of a business strategy to protect the integrity of the data estate.

Title: MS-102 Manage compliance in Microsoft 365
Description: This learning path provides instruction on managing the Microsoft 365 data governance features, including how to implement retention in email, sensitivity labels, and Windows Information Protection, and how to troubleshoot data loss prevention issues.

Title: Configure and manage Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads
Description: Configure and manage an existing Microsoft 365 tenant, from domains and licensing to resilience, workload settings, and content access for Microsoft Copilot.

Title: Empower your workforce with Microsoft Copilot
Description: In this interactive learning path, you perform a series of exercises to build your Copilot skills in role-related business scenarios. Roles include, Executives, Sales, Marketing, Finance, IT, HR, and Operations.

Title: Explore Microsoft Graph scenarios for JavaScript development
Description: This learning path includes hands-on exercises that will show you how to perform common tasks, such as showing a user's emails, accessing calendar events, and downloading and uploading files, in a JavaScript app using Microsoft Graph APIs.

Title: Deliver engaging and accessible virtual events with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365
Description: The one thing we can never get back is time. This is the most valuable thing an event attendee shares with you. Whether you are a seasoned producer or new to creating virtual events, this learning path walks you through the fundamentals of delivering compelling events using Microsoft 365 technology. Learn best practices for accessibility, inclusion, and engagement as you create your virtual event. Review processes that prioritize the clarity of your message, the attendee experience, and your ongoing engagement strategy. Compelling events are about people - this training includes content for event organizers, producers, moderators, and attendees.

Title: Explore the business value of generative AI solutions
Description: Discover how generative AI can transform your business processes and drive innovation.

Title: Build psychological safety
Description: Understand psychological safety, why it's important, and how to cultivate it on your team.

Title: Apply Viva Glint’s modern approach to engagement for better results
Description: Apply Viva Glint’s modern approach to engagement for better results. Designed to introduce a people-centric measurement strategy, describe how we use it, and detail how to empower action to drive better results.

Title: MD-020 Microsoft Surface administration
Description: The Surface Endpoint Admin Course covers the management and support of Surface devices, settings, support requests, security settings, the IT Toolkit, the Surface Management Portal, and more.

Title: Prepare the environment for a Microsoft Teams deployment
Description: Prepare the environment for a Microsoft Teams deployment

Title: Understand and share your Viva Glint results
Description: Make the most of your Viva Glint results by understanding reports and having ACT conversations with your team.

Title: Prepare infrastructure for devices using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID
Description: Learn how to configure Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune to support modern endpoint management. This learning path covers identity infrastructure, device enrollment, and automated deployment strategies for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, macOS, and Android devices.

Title: Govern and protect sensitive information in the age of AI
Description: Develop skills in securing and governing data within AI-driven environments, using Microsoft Purview to navigate AI risks and ensure compliance. This path enhances your understanding of adapting security and governance strategies in response to the evolving landscape of AI technology.

Title: Extend endpoint capabilities using Microsoft Intune Suite
Description: Learn how to extend Microsoft Intune with the Microsoft Intune Suite, including Remote Help, Endpoint Privilege Management, Advanced Endpoint Analytics, and other premium endpoint management capabilities.

Title: Get started with managing Microsoft Teams
Description: Get started with managing Microsoft Teams

Title: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with declarative agents using Visual Studio Code
Description: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with declarative agents is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending Microsoft 365 Copilot using Visual Studio Code. You learn what declarative agents are, how they work, and when you should consider building them. You also learn, how to extend them with skills and knowledge to make them more powerful and useful.

Title: Manage identity and access in Microsoft 365
Description: This learning path examines the threat vectors and data breaches organizations face today in their cybersecurity landscape, and the wide range of security solutions that Microsoft 365 provides to combat those threats.

Title: Enhance business workflows with AI
Description: This learning path enables students to use Microsoft Copilot to draft and refine business content, analyze and visualize data, manage meetings and collaboration, and delegate multi-step work with Copilot Cowork.

Title: Learn how Microsoft supports secure software development as part of a cybersecurity solution
Description: Secure software development means integrating security into each phase of your development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to maintenance. Microsoft provides many services that can help you develop more secure code and deploy a more secure application in the cloud. This learning path provides an overview of the services and offerings available to help you build secure software as part of a cybersecurity solution.The deadline for agencies to comply with NIST/CISA/OMB guidance on security measures for critical software (including applying practices of least privilege, network segmentation, and proper configuration), per section 4 of the Executive Order on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity, is **August 10, 2021**. The deadline for agencies to comply with the guidance identifying practices that enhance the security of the software supply chain with respect to software procurement, also per section 4, is **March 8, 2022**.

Title: Discover new Outlook for Windows
Description: Take control of your inbox, calendar, and contacts in the new Outlook for Windows experience and make the most of its powerful features.

Title: Establish the guiding principles and core components of Zero Trust
Description: Zero Trust is not a product or tool, but an essential security strategy that seeks to continuously verify every transaction, asserts least privilege access, and assumes that every transaction could be a possible attack.  Through the modules in this learning path, you'll gain an understanding of Zero Trust and how it applies to identity, endpoints, applications, networks, infrastructure, and data.

Title: Defend against threats with Microsoft 365
Description: Microsoft 365 includes security technologies that enterprises can use to secure email, data, devices, and identities against the risk of cyber threats. This learning path provides an introduction to Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Identity, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365.

Title: Use the Microsoft service adoption framework to drive adoption in your enterprise
Description: In this introductory course, you'll learn the six critical elements to drive adoption of your Microsoft cloud services to deliver value to your company. This course is applicable to any size company and uses Office 365 and Microsoft Teams as the example service to create real world scenarios.

Title: Drive business value with AI solutions
Description: Discover how Copilot and Azure AI can transform work across your organization.

Title: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot in .NET
Description: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending Copilot for Microsoft 365 in .NET. This series helps you understand what Copilot for Microsoft 365 is and how it works. It also explains why you should consider extending it to give it access to data in your organization and what options you have to extend it.

Title: Enhance your productivity with prebuilt Microsoft 365 Copilot agents
Description: This Learning Path explores how prebuilt agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot enable users to streamline tasks, retrieve information efficiently, and enhance productivity through AI-powered conversational tools.

Title: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams
Description: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams

Title: Learn how Microsoft safeguards customer data
Description: Learn how Microsoft safeguards customer data is designed for people in audit, compliance, risk, and legal roles who seek an overall understanding of Microsoft 365’s fundamental security and privacy practices to safeguard their customer data.

Title: Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot administration
Description: This learning path examines how to apply Zero Trust principles to Microsoft 365 Copilot and how to manage Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot administration.

Title: Manage chat, teams, channels, and apps in Microsoft Teams
Description: Manage chat, teams, channels, and apps in Microsoft Teams

Title: Extend declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot with API plugins using Visual Studio Code
Description: Extend declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot with API plugins is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending declarative agents with actions using API plugins. You learn what API plugins are, how they work, and when you should consider building them. You also learn how to use Adaptive Cards to show data in a rich way and how to connect to secured APIs.

Title: MS-102 Implement threat protection by using Microsoft Defender XDR
Description: This learning path examines how to manage the Microsoft 365 threat intelligence features that provide organizations with insight and protection against the internal and external cyber-attacks that threaten their tenants.  MS-102

Title: Deliver cloud-hosted desktops using Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365
Description: Learn how to plan, deploy, and manage cloud-hosted desktops using Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop, and integrate Cloud PCs and Azure Virtual Desktop session hosts with Microsoft Intune.

Title: Explore Microsoft 365 administration
Description: This Learning Path introduces the Microsoft 365 experience by helping you set up core services, manage users and access securely, and protect your organization’s data using built-in tools and best practices.

Title: MS-102 Configure your Microsoft 365 tenant
Description: This learning path provides instruction on how to configure your Microsoft 365 tenant, including your organizational profile, tenant subscriptions, user accounts and licenses, groups, custom domains, and client connectivity.

Title: MS-102 Manage your Microsoft 365 tenant
Description: This learning path provides instruction on how to manage your Microsoft 365 tenant, including administrative roles, tenant health and services, Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise, and workplace analytics using Microsoft Viva Insights.

Description: Collaborating with Microsoft Teams

Title: Protect devices using Microsoft Intune
Description: Learn how to secure endpoints with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender, including device encryption, compliance policies, advanced threat protection, Microsoft Tunnel VPN, and Microsoft Cloud PKI.

Title: MS-721 Plan and design Teams collaboration communications systems
Description: Learn how to plan, design, and deploy Microsoft Teams collaboration communications systems with Microsoft Teams meetings, Teams Phone, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Surface Hub, and other shared space devices.

Title: Manage meetings and calling in Microsoft Teams
Description: Learn the meetings and calling features in Microsoft Teams, including managing meetings experiences, managing Microsoft Teams devices, managing calling features with Calling Plans and Microsoft Teams, and the basic troubleshooting tool for Teams issue.

Title: Extend Microsoft Copilot in Copilot Studio
Description: Build agents that extend Microsoft Copilot with additional knowledge and capabilities. Use Copilot Studio to build declarative agents, add knowledge, add tools, and publish agents to Copilot.

Title: Learn how Microsoft supports data discovery, classification, and protection as part of a cybersecurity solution
Description: Know your data, protect your data, and don't lose your data. These are the basic tenets of good information protection - data discovery, classification, and protection. This learning path provides an overview of the Microsoft data protection capabilities and how to use them to protect and govern data as part of a cybersecurity solution.The deadline for the heads of federal civilian agencies to evaluate and classify agency data and provide to DHS and OMB a report of their evaluation, per Section 8 of the Executive Order on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity, is **August 24, 2021**.

Title: Learn how Microsoft supports using multifactor authentication as part of a cybersecurity solution
Description: Multifactor authentication helps secure your environment and resources by requiring that your users confirm their identity by using multiple authentication methods, like a phone call, text message, mobile app notification, or one-time password. You can use multifactor authentication both on-premises and in the cloud to add security for accessing Microsoft online services, remote access applications, and more. This learning path provides an overview of how to use multifactor authentication as part of a cybersecurity solution.The deadline for agencies to adopt multifactor authentication and encryption at rest and in transit to the maximum extent (and report on progress every 60 days), per Section 3 of the Executive Order on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity, is **November 8, 2021**.

Title: MS-721 Manage Teams collaboration communications systems
Description: Discover how to manage Teams collaboration communications systems, including Microsoft Teams meetings, Teams Phone, Microsoft Teams Rooms, BYOD rooms, bookable desks, Microsoft Places, and other devices. You'll learn how to manage Teams users, Teams devices, and perform common troubleshooting tasks.

Title: Manage applications using Microsoft Intune
Description: Learn how to deploy and manage applications with Microsoft Intune, including app protection policies, application lifecycle management, performance monitoring, and the Enterprise App Catalog.
